text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to win today! I'll win and show everyone
that even walls can be overcome.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"And then... I'm going to give
Zephyr some courage!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower is full of motivation.
When it comes to doing things for others, she demonstrates an astonishing amount of power. Surely today as well...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She's going to show us the ultimate run!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: You're so cool for being able to work hard for others.
You're so cool for being able to work hard for others.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure Zephyr-san is challenging something
far tougher than I ever have.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know if I can be of help.
But I want to help. Because...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Having people who cheer me on
makes me so very happy and blessed.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I want to encourage Zephyr-san too.
I want to support the cool Zephyr-san
who works so hard for others' sake.)
